title: Present installation plans and outcomes
description: Present bounded preliminary plans and actual installation results through the existing human/structured contract, preserving unperformed checks, conflict and replacement distinctions, and private-data restrictions.
inputs: Admitted request, bundled inventory, selected destination and explicit force intent.
Available acquisition, preflight, installation, and safe network diagnostic facts.
outputs: Nonmutating preliminary plan or actual blocked/completed/partial result with supported exit meaning.
Actionable bounded diagnostics and explicit checks not performed.
behavior: For dry-run, describe destinations and preliminary conflicts/replacements from bundled information without acquisition, extraction, or project mutation.
Keep preliminary checks separate from full archive-verified preflight and preserve actual replacement/partial-effect distinctions.
Explain whole-unit force scope and loss of local modifications inside replaced units without suggesting unrelated replacement.
Preserve the retained result envelopes, exit classes, safe proxy variable names/status values, and verified local-archive fallback.
Exclude credentials, raw proxy values, private hosts/users, headers, environment dumps, and machine-local archive paths; do not add network probes or a proxy dispatcher.

failure_behavior.condition: Information needed for complete preflight or installation has not been obtained.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report its unperformed scope rather than a verified plan or success.

failure_behavior.condition: Network capability or failure cause is uncertain.
failure_behavior.outcome: Use the permitted unknown status and bounded observed facts instead of guessing or exposing private details.
